note: Both sets are largely accurate and share 21 identical claims, but Set B binds the wall-base claim to tag WB and preserves the MDF material from the profile field, which Set A truncates to "4\" H x 1/2\" THK". Set B also binds the accent-paint colour to P3 (Accent Paint) explicitly, whereas Set A leaves it as the bare description "ACCENT PAINT". Both sets invent a "KITCHEN" location for the quartz and restate the glass location as "BATHROOM SHOWER" (the sheet says SHOWER SURROUND), and both omit the same facts (tile style/colour numbers, Fireclay Tile as GT manufacturer, P3 colour number 33-14, several millwork rows and quantities).
remarks: The QZ (quartz) block on the sheet has no LOCATION field at all, so the "location: KITCHEN" condition in both sets is unsupported; the GL location reads "SHOWER SURROUND", not "BATHROOM SHOWER". Both sets also leave out notable finish-schedule data (PT1/PT2 style numbers FGEEOB412/FGEEOB1224, colour OBSIDIAN BLACK, GT manufacturer FIRECLAY TILE / style CRUSH / colour DANDELION, P3 colour number 33-14 and finishes, WB finish and location) and millwork rows MWK01, MWK03, MWK04, MWB01, MWL01, MWD02 with their quantities. The text layer scrambles the millwork table row/column order, so row-to-dimension binding must be checked against the image; both sets did this correctly for the rows they used.
